cross_architecture_judgment: CARE-ASE is direct asymmetric reconstruction inside one mature trunk, not a residual-correction, retrieval-memory, cascade, selector or ensemble system.
Scar and pure edema require distinct evidence ownership, branch topology, sampling and negative spaces; a generic shared pathology head is a downgrade.
Every proposal, context, extent, injury and boundary tensor must have a testable causal route to its intended final logit rather than existing only as a named auxiliary.
The no-T2 rule is both computational and semantic: no edema-owned call or gradient and no class-4 participation in the loss/decode denominator.
Anatomy geometry is detached soft context only; hard wall transforms, crops, clipping and geometry fail-stop are excluded.
